bullets.section: Business model I am learning more about —
bullets.title: The Resilience of Costco
bullets.note: This takes just 5-10 minutes to digest. The gist: “For 40 years, Costco has succeeded with a simple formula: reinvest merchandising profits into lower prices and better products; be a disciplined operator; and treat customers and employees well.” This is a great study in simplicity (drastically reducing SKUs, per slide 44, and keeping the stores barebone, per slide 70), contrarian decision-making (no expensive advertising, per slide 54, and only offering bulk sizes, per slide 58), and much, much more. It also makes one wonder where Amazon Prime memberships will take Amazon, retail, and the world at large...

bullets.title: My Wage
bullets.note: B. Rittenhouse**. I found this in [_The ONE Thing_](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/xmumv0zqqa6h7l2go/6gteh8hkkv9edl/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYW1hem9uLmNvbS9PTkUtVGhpbmctU3VycHJpc2luZ2x5LUV4dHJhb3JkaW5hcnktUmVzdWx0cy9kcC8xODg1MTY3Nzc2), written by Gary Keller ([@garykeller](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/xmumv0zqqa6h7l2go/qnc8h7h77gkp0q/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZmFjZWJvb2suY29tL2dhcnlrZWxsZXI=)) and Jay Papasan ([@jaypapasan](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/xmumv0zqqa6h7l2go/3esphkhoo6pgn0/aHR0cHM6Ly90d2l0dGVyLmNvbS9qYXlwYXBhc2Fu)). Gary is the founder and chairman of the board of Keller Williams Realty, the world's largest real estate franchise by agent count, and he carries this poem with him. I picked up _The ONE Thing_ for the second time after [Allen Walton](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/xmumv0zqqa6h7l2go/w5a2hgh5590636/aHR0cHM6Ly90aW0uYmxvZy8yMDE4LzEyLzEwL2FsbGVuLXdhbHRvbi00LWhvdXItd29ya3dlZWstY2FzZS1zdHVkeS8_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1jb252ZXJ0a2l0JnV0bV9tZWRpdW09Y29udmVydGtpdCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249NWJm) and a few other [_4-Hour Workweek_](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/xmumv0zqqa6h7l2go/89bqhoh00ernx6/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYW1hem9uLmNvbS80LUhvdXItV29ya3dlZWstRXNjYXBlLUxpdmUtQW55d2hlcmUvZHAvMDMwNzQ2NTM1Nw==) case studies recently mentioned the book’s impact on their early growth.

bullets.title: doTERRA Peppermint Essential Oil Beadlets 125 ct
bullets.note: These are odd but fantastic. Think of them as sugar- and sweetener-free Altoids with the mouthfeel of peppermint caviar balls. The first tube was gifted to me by a friend in Salt Lake City, and I’ve since bought many more. I have no affiliation with the company, which is based in Utah and appears to have had [some interesting run-ins with government agencies](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/xmumv0zqqa6h7l2go/ozukhqhkk3qd7z/aHR0cHM6Ly9lbi53aWtpcGVkaWEub3JnL3dpa2kvRG9UZXJyYQ==).
